question:
The following table shows the production of different types of water bottles (in thousands) in different years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/975a06757bbc97c93ed584189e0f19f9ac75a43746fd14eca2a65d0ee18e96d9.png] 

The production of which type of water bottles was highest in the year 2012?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Production of water bottle A in 2012 = 473

Production of water bottle B in 2012 = 560

Production of water bottle C in 2012 = 780

⇒ The highest production of water bottle in 2012 is of C, i.e., 780.

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
